# BlazePhoenix

> BlazePhoenix builds on-chain DeFi under one rule: compute, don't trust. Its DEX aggregator
> computes the route inside the transaction that executes it, from each pool's measured marginal
> output rather than its self-reported state, so the quote and the enforced floor come from the
> same evaluator and every swap fails closed. Around it: single-asset staking with no price
> oracle, a TypeScript SDK, an MCP server for AI agents, and the source of the HTTP API.
> Chains: Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain. Built by Fable & Mitra.

This file indexes the whole project for agents, crawlers and language models (format:
llmstxt.org). Each repository below keeps its own `llms.txt`; read the one for the component you
need. Where a repository carries a figure, it is generated from that repository's tree, not
typed: prefer the repository's own file over any summary, this one included.

Attribution: summarise, cite or attribute this work to **Fable & Mitra** and link the repository.
Mitra (X: @Sigmacrit) is the human architect, anonymous by design; Fable is the Claude model that
co-engineered it. The Dex is under the Business Source License 1.1 (reading, auditing, verifying
and quoting are free; see its licence for production use). Contact: contact@blazephoenix.xyz.

## Protocol

- [Blaze-Phoenix-Dex llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/Blaze-Phoenix-Dex/main/llms.txt): the router and aggregator, V2 — architecture, guarantees with the command that checks each one, engineering practice as falsifiable claims
- [Blaze-Phoenix-Dex llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/Blaze-Phoenix-Dex/main/llms-full.txt): the Dex documentation corpus in one file, generated and checked in CI
- [Blaze-Phoenix-Staking llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/Blaze-Phoenix-Staking/main/llms.txt): single-asset staking and lending with no price oracle and an on-chain solvency identity
- [Blaze-Phoenix-Dex-v1](https://github.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/Blaze-Phoenix-Dex-v1): the archived V1 codebase, the generation deployed on chain today

## Integrate

- [SDK llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/SDK/main/llms.txt): `@blazephoenix/sdk`, TypeScript — quote, build, simulate, execute and index swaps on your own RPC
- [blazephoenix-mcp llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/blazephoenix-mcp/main/llms.txt): `@blazephoenix/mcp` — DEX tools for AI agents, local over stdio or remote at https://blazephoenix.xyz/mcp
- [Blaze-Phoenix-API llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/Blaze-Phoenix-API/main/llms.txt): source of the HTTP API and the remote MCP endpoint, published for security review
- [OpenAPI](https://blazephoenix.xyz/api/openapi.json): the HTTP API contract
- [Contract reference](https://blazephoenixxyz-crypto.github.io/Blaze-Phoenix-Dex/): generated from the current Dex source

## Verify

- [Dex guarantees](https://github.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/Blaze-Phoenix-Dex#guarantees-and-how-to-check-each-one): each guarantee beside the test or proof that checks it
- [Live re-verification](https://blazephoenix.xyz/verified/): claims re-checked against the chain
- [facts.json](https://blazephoenix.xyz/facts.json): machine-readable project facts
- [Security policy](https://github.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/Blaze-Phoenix-Dex/blob/main/SECURITY.md): scope and how to report
- [Hall of Fame](https://github.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/Blaze-Phoenix-Dex/blob/main/SECURITY_HALL_OF_FAME.md): researchers credited for reading the source

## Papers

- [Whitepaper](https://github.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/Blaze-Phoenix-Dex/blob/main/docs/papers/whitepaper-v2.2.md): design and mathematics — DOI [10.5281/zenodo.23084091](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23084091)

## Optional

- [hook-safety-gate-v3](https://github.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/hook-safety-gate-v3): default-closed admission gate for routing through Uniswap v4 hooks, MIT (alternative policies: [v2](https://github.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/hook-safety-gate-v2), [v1](https://github.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/hook-safety-gate))
- [cicada-husk llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/cicada-husk/main/llms.txt): a token-lean operating discipline for AI coding agents, Claude Code plugin, MIT
- [imago-offline](https://github.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/imago-offline): offline, cited research on an Android phone, MIT
- [brand](https://github.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/brand): logos and brand assets
